topic: Applying LG model changes to production data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on applying a new Unique User (LG) calculation model, initially tested on staging, to the production environment for Germany. 

Key points included:
*   **Model Scope:** The LG model was confirmed to be applicable to all sensors, not just new ones.
*   **Data Integrity:** It was established that simply copying the staging dataset to production is incorrect because parts of the production data do not equal the staging data. Instead, only the Unique User calculation needs updating (using LG) while retaining the existing model for older sensors on production.
*   **Validation:** The team validated the results, noting a drop in unique users from 17 million to 6.9 million across all units. Crucially, the total traffic remained unchanged, confirming the mathematical accuracy of the prediction model.

The final decision was made to apply the changes to production.
decisions: The LG Unique User calculation model will be applied to the production environment for Germany.
The new unique user calculation must only change the methodology (using LG) and not overwrite existing sensor models or data structures.
action_items: Verify that all systems are working correctly on production after applying the changes.
